paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a microwave cavity haloscope. Sets 95% CL limit g_aγγ >= 3e-12 GeV^-1 over 63.2-67.1 µeV (15.28-16.23 GHz), excluding ALP cogenesis. Local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed (all axions). The stated limit is approximately flat ~3e-12 GeV^-1; encoded as horizontal line across the mass range.
